title: Meeting Dr Fred

nodes.speaker: Dr Fred Matombo
nodes.text: Unless you’re about to stop breathing or processing, please could you come back tomorrow?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Unless you’re about to stop breathing or processing, please could you come back tomorrow?

nodes.speaker: Dr Fred Matombo
nodes.text: And I just have fifteen patients who can’t speak let alone make conversation, so…

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And I just have fifteen patients who can’t speak let alone make conversation, so…

nodes.speaker: Dr Fred Matombo
nodes.text: I don’t know, are you a bio-synth phlebotomist specializing in intravenous shielding repair?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don’t know, are you a bio-synth phlebotomist specializing in intravenous shielding repair?

nodes.speaker: Dr Fred Matombo
nodes.text: I’m sorry, it’s just... I forgot, how people interact outside of all of this. I can take thirty seconds. Need to breathe anyway.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I’m sorry, it’s just... I forgot, how people interact outside of all of this. I can take thirty seconds. Need to breathe anyway.

nodes.speaker: Dr Fred Matombo
nodes.text: Won’t lie, it’s a nightmare. Ransomware viruses, data rot, black-market augs gone septic, dermis-eating parasites…

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Won’t lie, it’s a nightmare. Ransomware viruses, data rot, black-market augs gone septic, dermis-eating parasites…

nodes.speaker: Dr Fred Matombo
nodes.text: Thanks. And be careful. LifeCorp don't exactly play.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks. And be careful. LifeCorp don't exactly play.

nodes.speaker: Dr Fred Matombo
nodes.text: Yeah, well... fatal infections don't exactly obey the law. Speaking of which, I really have to go. If you get that Bio-X you know where to find me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, well... fatal infections don't exactly obey the law. Speaking of which, I really have to go. If you get that Bio-X you know where to find me.

nodes.speaker: Dr Fred Matombo
nodes.text: Have you heard of BioX-50? It’s a proprietary antibiotic produced by MedSynge, but they don’t allow non-subscribers access. I'm desperate for some.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Have you heard of BioX-50? It’s a proprietary antibiotic produced by MedSynge, but they don’t allow non-subscribers access. I'm desperate for some.

nodes.speaker: Dr Fred Matombo
nodes.text: Most EMaTs carry it. Some vendors if a MedSynge shipment gets jacked. I haven’t had time to go searching.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Most EMaTs carry it. Some vendors if a MedSynge shipment gets jacked. I haven’t had time to go searching.

nodes.speaker: Dr Fred Matombo
nodes.text: I'm a doctor. Period. I trained because I wanted to help people, not to up-sell them LifeCorp premiums.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm a doctor. Period. I trained because I wanted to help people, not to up-sell them LifeCorp premiums.

nodes.speaker: Dr Fred Matombo
nodes.text: Thanks to LifeCorp, this is as close to a "proper" clinic as it's possible to get in Nivalis.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks to LifeCorp, this is as close to a "proper" clinic as it's possible to get in Nivalis.

nodes.speaker: Dr Fred Matombo
nodes.text: I'd rather not. You don't know where they've been.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'd rather not. You don't know where they've been.

nodes.speaker: Dr Fred Matombo
nodes.text: Mmmhmm. If you'll excuse me, I have real work to do.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mmmhmm. If you'll excuse me, I have real work to do.

nodes.speaker: Dr Fred Matombo
nodes.text: Why would you help me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why would you help me?

nodes.speaker: Dr Fred Matombo
nodes.text: Thanks for the offer, but I've heard about the kind of people you do business with. Can't take the risk. Sorry.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks for the offer, but I've heard about the kind of people you do business with. Can't take the risk. Sorry.

nodes.speaker: Dr Fred Matombo
nodes.text: I'd heard from a few people that you're on the wrong side of the corps. Which is the right side for me. There is something you could do...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'd heard from a few people that you're on the wrong side of the corps. Which is the right side for me. There is something you could do...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Just making conversation.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just making conversation.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is there anything I can do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is there anything I can do?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Is there anything I can do?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Is there anything I can do?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not really, no.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not really, no.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Alright, alright, forget it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright, alright, forget it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Your work sounds intense.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your work sounds intense.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is there anything I can do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is there anything I can do?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Is there anything I can do?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Is there anything I can do?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll see what I can do.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll see what I can do.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'll see what I can do.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'll see what I can do.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds illegal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds illegal.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Where do I get it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Where do I get it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why don't you work in a proper clinic?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why don't you work in a proper clinic?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why don't you work in a proper clinic?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why don't you work in a proper clinic?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you're a backstreet doctor?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you're a backstreet doctor?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If people don't have a LifeCorp subscription that's their problem.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If people don't have a LifeCorp subscription that's their problem.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If people don't have a LifeCorp subscription that's their problem.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If people don't have a LifeCorp subscription that's their problem.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fuck the corps, eh?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fuck the corps, eh?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Well, good luck.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, good luck.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Just trying to make this city a better place.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just trying to make this city a better place.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Just trying to make this city a better place.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Just trying to make this city a better place.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I scratch your back, you scratch mine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I scratch your back, you scratch mine.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I scratch your back, you scratch mine.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I scratch your back, you scratch mine.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Go on.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Go on.
